newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks firm on short-covering at close.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks firm on short-covering at close.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed higher on Wednesday mainly on short-covering by speculators in select blue chips, but early rises were slightly trimmed by selling of Hub Power shares.

"The index ended up on short-covering as trading activity increased towards the close, but Hub Power remained under pressure because of the fall in its GDR (Global Depositary Receipt) rates," dealer Shakil Anwar said.
The index rose 7.87 points, or 0.50 percent, to end at 1,570.96. Losers beat gainers 138 to 125. PTCL rose 0.55 to 29.25. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
